g.text: ESP32-S3 Mini & WS2812B Dual-Strip Wiring Diagram
Shared 5V DC common power supply, decoupling capacitor, and direct 3.3V GPIO LED drive
Red Wire : +5V VCC (Shared ESP32 & LED strip power)
Green Wire : Serial Data DIN (3.3V GPIO 2 / GPIO 3)
Configurable : NUM_LEDS & NUM_STRIPS in config header
• 1000 µF (10V–25V) capacitor directly across DC jack
• Generous 5V PSU (up to 10A) prevents any voltage sag
• Common ground (GND) strictly required across all modules
